records.purpose: Distinguish perimeter from area as different attributes.
records.use_when: Introducing perimeter/area or when formulas are confused.
records.setup: One rectangle on squared paper; string optional.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 用线表示周长，用方格表示面积。两个量分别在测什么？单位为什么不同？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Use a line to show perimeter and squares to show area. What does each measure? Why are the units different?
records.expected_thinking: Perimeter measures boundary length in linear units; area measures interior surface in square units.
records.listen_for: Using the same units or formula for both attributes.
records.variation: Draw two rectangles with equal perimeter and different areas.

records.title_zh: 先数单位方格，再得到公式
records.title_en: Count unit squares before using a formula
records.purpose: Derive rectangle area from equal square units and array structure.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 不用逐格数，怎样利用4行、每行6格得到总面积？为什么4×6表示平方单位数量？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Without counting every square, how can 4 rows of 6 squares give the total area? Why does 4×6 count square units?
records.expected_thinking: Rows × squares per row counts the 24 unit squares covering the rectangle.
records.listen_for: Applying length×width with no connection to square units.
records.variation: Use a partially covered grid and ask pupils to infer missing squares.

records.title_zh: 从已知图形推导新公式
records.title_en: Derive a new area formula from a known shape
records.setup: Two congruent triangles cut from paper or diagrammed.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 把两个全等三角形拼成一个平行四边形。三角形面积为什么是对应平行四边形的一半？
records.teacher_prompt_en: Join two congruent triangles to make a parallelogram. Why is one triangle half the area of the corresponding parallelogram?
records.expected_thinking: Two congruent triangles exactly compose the parallelogram, so each has half its area.
records.listen_for: Reciting 1/2×base×height without explaining the half relationship.
records.variation: Rearrange a parallelogram into a rectangle to derive its formula.

records.title_zh: 一层多少个，一共有几层
records.title_en: How many per layer, and how many layers?
records.setup: 4×3 base with 2 layers of unit cubes or a drawing.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 每一层有多少个单位立方体？有几层？总共有多少个？这和4×3×2有什么关系？
records.teacher_prompt_en: How many unit cubes are in one layer? How many layers are there? How many cubes altogether? How does this connect to 4×3×2?
records.expected_thinking: Each layer has 12 cubes and two layers give 24 cubic units.
records.listen_for: Counting only visible faces/cubes; confusing square units and cubic units.
records.variation: Change only the height and predict the new volume.

records.title_zh: 为什么单位是立方单位
records.purpose: Connect the volume formula to three-dimensional units.
records.setup: Use a 4 cm × 3 cm × 2 cm cuboid.
records.teacher_prompt_zh: 4×3×2=24。为什么答案是24 cm³，不是24 cm²？公式里的三个长度分别在数什么？
records.teacher_prompt_en: 4×3×2=24. Why is the answer 24 cm³ rather than 24 cm²? What does each dimension count?
records.expected_thinking: The dimensions determine rows, columns and layers of 1 cm³ cubes.
records.listen_for: Choosing units by memorised suffix without unit-cube meaning.
records.variation: Use fractional edge lengths where curriculum placement supports it.
